## Description

Server side for native clients: OIDC code + PKCE token endpoints, refresh rotation, patient sign-in by mobile number + SMS code, device registration (device key, platform, app version), push token registry, per-device and all-device revoke (feeds the 'My devices' screen and staff offboarding MDV-P1-009), rate limits and audit. Every endpoint declares a policy; tenant isolation unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a staff member is offboarded, when the owner confirms, then every mobile session and push token of that person is revoked at once.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a refresh token is replayed, when the server sees it twice, then the whole token family is revoked and the event is audited.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a wrong SMS code is entered five times, when the limit is reached, then the number is locked for a period and the patient is told in plain words.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a lost phone is reported, when the user revokes it in My devices, then the next request from that device is refused.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
